summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands-on experience in ML model optimization, CUDA kernel engineering, and edge deployment. Skilled in PyTorch, TensorRT, 8-bit quantization, and inference profiling, with a track record of fine-tuning transformer models and building training pipelines from scratch. Background spans embedded C/C++, perception pipelines, and high-performance computing.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a custom data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with medical imaging augmentation and batch-loading memory management for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.
Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU, reporting accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.
Led a cross-cultural team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced student, restructuring task distribution to deliver the full pipeline within a 6-week window.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API, adding domain-specific special tokens and resizing decoder embeddings.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom object detection dataset and trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 images, achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation.
Exported the trained model to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC: <1% accuracy degradation with +0.09 perplexity increase, near-lossless compression.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant memory for weights/biases.
Coalesced kernel ran at 49.2ms vs 73.3ms (uncoalesced) and 77.5ms (CPU TorchScript), a ~35% speedup with identical classification accuracy.

projects.name: COFFIN — Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline: 80-channel mel spectrogram encoder, 4-block causal Transformer decoder with cross-attention, trained on 1,000 Indian-English samples (NPTEL 2020) achieving training loss ~0.51.
Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with a Cython-accelerated backend achieving 4-5.5x speedup over pure Python; achieved 15% WER on the NPTEL 2020 Indian-English dataset.
